 MyDCD opens below IPO price on ACE Market debut
 TheEdge 
 Tue, Nov 17, 2026 09:24am - 2 hours 
 View Original 
 KUALA LUMPUR (Nov 17): MyDCD Bhd (KL: MYDCD ) fell in its ACE Market listing debut on Tuesday amid broader selldown on investments related to data centres.
 The engineering services firm, which derives its revenue entirely from working on data centres, opened at 48 sen compared to its initial public offering (IPO) price of 56 sen per share. MyDCD fell to as low as 47 sen and was trading at 50.5 sen at 9.15am as nearly 53 million shares changed hands.
 Market capitalisation stood at RM904 million based on the last price.
 MyDCD’s debut comes barely hours after the US announced restrictions on exports of artificial intelligence (AI) chips to data centres in Malaysia and other Asian countries in a bid to curb China’s access to the advanced semiconductors.
 Other firms that have significant exposure to data centres also declined on Tuesday, including SKA Capital Bhd (KL: SKACAP ) listed just last week.
 MyDCD mainly provides mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection — a group of services known as MEPF that covers a building's indoor systems such as air-conditioning, electrical distribution, water supply, and fire alarms.
 Ahead of the listing, investors snapped up MyDCD’s shares, with the public portion oversubscribed 36 times.
 The IPO raised RM187.6 million for the company through the issuance of new shares.
 The company is allocating RM134 million for working capital, mainly to support project execution and performance bonds, and RM39.9 million for business expansion, including recruitment, additional office space and staff training.
 Another RM5 million is earmarked for information technology upgrades, while the remaining RM8.7 million will cover listing expenses.
 An offer for sale under the IPO, meanwhile, raised RM81.2 million for a group of eight shareholders and senior management — Ng Kok Hoong, Kwan Siew Peng, Ng Gek Khoon, Yew Kim Keong, Khairil Husni Azri Mohd Hashim, Ngooi Siew Luan, Hon Mau Hoong, and Wong Kok Fong.
 TA Securities Holdings Sdn Bhd is the principal adviser, sponsor, underwriter and placement agent for the IPO.
